correctness.rationale: Newton identities over Z/p² with 2,3 invertible reduce all d≥3 to three sums; mod-p multiset classification; all lifts obey rank-r Vandermonde systems with p^(6−r) solutions. Summing three multiplicity strata proves J(p²)=16p⁶−27p⁵+12p⁴; CRT and unitary Fourier orthogonality then give the exact norm and endpoint profile. Strict convexity yields the stated extremizers. Verified independently by complete enumerations p=5,7 and product 35. No finite check is used as infinite proof.
